definitions.gloss: richness; body; depth of flavor; full-bodied taste
definitions.explanation: A quality of food or drink that has a deep, rich, multi-layered flavor. Describes a satisfying complexity and fullness of taste.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スープ→スープ：00395_suupu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧コク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This soup has a rich depth of flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦バター→バター：04671_bataa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{加|くわ}える→加える：01941_kuwaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧コク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Adding butter brings out a rich flavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{煮込|にこ}む→煮込む：05822_nikomu⟧ことで、⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧コク⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦カレー→カレー：02898_karee⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}がった→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧。
examples.english: By simmering for a long time, the curry turned out with a deep, rich flavor.

notes:
A key word in Japanese food culture with no single English equivalent. コク refers to the overall richness and depth of flavor — a combination of umami, fat, sweetness, and complexity that makes food taste satisfying. Often written in katakana.

USAGE:
Most commonly used with ⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧/⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: コク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (rich/full-bodied) vs コク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (lacking depth). Also used with ⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to come out): コク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (richness develops).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have richness/body
- コク⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: for richness to develop
- コク⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: a rich-flavored taste
- コク⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{旨味|うまみ}→旨味：06998_umami⟧: richness and umami
- コク{深|ぶか}い: deeply rich (often used for coffee, chocolate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{旨味|うまみ}→旨味：06998_umami⟧: umami — the savory taste itself, one component of コク
- ⟦{濃厚|のうこう}→濃厚：07905_noukou⟧: rich, thick — describes concentration or thickness of flavor
- ⟦{深|ふか}み→深み：13333_fukami⟧: depth — more general, can apply to flavor but also other contexts
